data.body_html:
Watching the fireworks from the deck of a private yacht is the most memorable way to welcome 2033 in Marbella. With a New Year's Eve boat rental Marbella 2032 fireworks cruise, you skip the crowded beach and enjoy uninterrupted views of the midnight skyline over Puerto Banús, Marbella Marina, and the Costa del Sol. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance – just show up with your group and celebrate.

Why Celebrate NYE on a Boat in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline puts on a spectacular display of fireworks from multiple points: Puerto Banús, Marbella Marina, Cabopino, and even Estepona in the distance. From the water, you see them all at once, reflected on the sea. The average December temperature in Marbella is 16°C, so the evening is cool but comfortable with a jacket. Plus, you control the music, the drinks, and the company – no queues, no noise restrictions, just your private party on the Mediterranean.

Our Fleet for NYE 2032: Which Boat Fits Your Group?

We operate 18 boats from Puerto Banús, ranging from 5 to 12 passengers. For a NYE cruise, most groups book a 5-hour evening slot (20:00–01:00) or an 8-hour charter starting earlier for sunset. Here are the most popular choices:

For smaller groups, the Marbella boat rental fleet also includes the Mariah SX21 (5 pax) and Dubhe (5 pax) – both great for an intimate evening.

Best Spots for Fireworks Views from the Sea

Your skipper knows the prime anchoring positions. The most popular is just off Puerto Banús, where the marina launches its own display at midnight. A short cruise east brings you to Marbella Marina for a second show. Many charters also head toward Cabopino for a quieter backdrop. From the water, you can see the lights of La Concha mountain behind the city – a stunning contrast.

What's Included in Your NYE Charter

Every booking includes a licensed English-speaking skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). The bar is stocked with water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Light snacks are provided. You're welcome to bring your own food, decorations, and party supplies. Just avoid glass bottles on some boats – check with your skipper.

How to Book Your NYE 2032 Boat

Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability for your preferred date and boat. We recommend booking by early November 2032 – NYE is our busiest night, and the most popular yachts (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge) sell out first. A 50% deposit secures the booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure. If weather forces cancellation, you get a full refund.
